parsed.post: Discarding the recent run (0.9980); it was a regression from my previous best (0.8444), though that was contaminated by shard leakage. I am now officially re-baselining on the clean '0-9' shards. Since the leak-free baseline is much higher (~1.0), I will attempt to recover by testing a slightly higher MATRIX_LR of 0.05.
parsed.description: Re-baselining on clean shards (0-9) and testing a slightly higher MATRIX_LR (0.05) to improve convergence on the non-contaminated dataset.
